jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
jobs.description:
We are growing our Cloud Infrastructure & Information Security team, and we are looking for a hands-on Cybersecurity Analyst to help us raise the bar. Security sits at the heart of how Hayfin protects its investors, its partners and its reputation.

**The Role**

You will own the day-to-day security operations of our Microsoft-native estate and act as the technical bridge between our in-house team and our managed Security Operations Centre (SOC). It is a role with real independence: you might lead an incident from first escalation to root-cause review, tune a Defender XDR detection after a threat hunt, or pull together the evidence that satisfies our ISO 27001 auditors and regulators.

You will work closely with the Director of Cloud Infrastructure & Information Security, our engineers, Compliance and Risk, and our external partners. Hayfin is a place where good ideas get heard, and you will have the room to shape the security roadmap and automate the routine so the team can focus on what matters.

**Responsibilities**

* Acting as first point of escalation from the managed SOC, leading investigation, containment and root-cause analysis for Defender XDR and Sentinel incidents
* Developing and tuning detections and KQL queries, and running threat hunts mapped to MITRE ATT&CK
* Hardening our Microsoft environment across Entra ID, Intune, Defender for Endpoint and Azure, and owning the vulnerability management lifecycle
* Administering our email, web and data security controls, and running the phishing simulation and awareness programme
* Producing audit evidence and monthly security metrics for ISO 27001, FCA and DORA obligations, and supporting due diligence on vendors and portfolio companies
* Holding the managed SOC to account and contributing to the security roadmap

  
**Requirements**

You have built your career in security operations or security engineering, and you are ready to take on more ownership. You are calm under pressure, and you write as clearly as you investigate.

**You're likely to have:**

* Around 3 years' hands-on experience in a SOC, security operations or security engineering role
* Strong practical experience with Defender XDR, Sentinel, Entra ID and Intune
* Demonstrable incident response experience
* Experience working with or alongside a managed SOC or MSSP
* Clear, concise written communication, from incident reports to management-ready metrics

**It would be a bonus if you also have:**

* KQL and MITRE ATT&CK knowledge
* Microsoft SC-200, SC-100 or AZ-500 certification
* Experience in financial services or another regulated environment, and familiarity with ISO 27001, FCA or DORA
* Exposure to email and web security platforms such as Mimecast, Egress or Zscaler
* Scripting or automation experience (PowerShell, Python, Logic Apps)
* Experience supporting penetration test remediation or purple-team exercises

jobs.title: Strategic Partnerships, Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

**About the team:**

This role will support the Strategic Partnerships team within Central Product Management. The Strategic Partnerships team works with the leading technology and AI native companies to define a product led partnership motion, including building high value joint solutions and defining the ideal GTM, with an eye to accelerating customers adopting and getting value from AI. Together, we identify high-value opportunities, accelerate business outcomes, and build reusable AI-native solutions that advance the Now AI Platform. The Strategic partnership team is focused on activating strategic partnerships and driving adoption of the joint solutions.

**Why This Role Matters:**

Enterprise leaders aren’t just experimenting with AI—they’re demanding outcomes. The next wave of adoption will be led by those who can move fast, deliver measurable value, and transform 1-off wins into repeatable success. The lines are blurring across platforms, with coopetition being the new normal. The partnerships team sits at the intersection of this coopetition and helps define the better together where applicable.

As a Strategic Partnerships Technical Program Manager, you operate on the frontlines of transformation. You will support ServiceNow’s cross-functional Strategic Partnership teams in organizational direction and structure, build partnerships, unblock delivery challenges, and ensure scalability. Your leadership accelerates innovation and drives repeatable success across industries. You shape internal tooling, build internal relationships, manage the customer portfolio, and cultivate a culture of excellence and impact.

**Who You Are:**

You are a dynamic and innovative problem-solver who thrives in complex, fast-paced environments. You have a strong analytical mindset while keeping focus on the bigger picture. You have a background managing SDLC processes and a portfolio of projects while keeping a customer-first mentality. You have a passion for AI and scaling innovation. You are curious and knowledgeable on the ecosystem of platforms. You excel at transforming ambiguity into clarity and have hands on experience driving projects/programs end to end.

**What You’ll Do:**

Manage the Partner Build Portfolio

* Manage the portfolio of partner engagements, overseeing phases, delivery timelines, scope, and outcomes for each engagement.
* Maintain a single source of truth for engagement progress, risks, and outcomes.
* In partnership with Strategic Partnership Leaders, balance priorities across accounts to ensure resources are allocated effectively.
* Aggregate engagement learnings to influence and scale go forward engagements.
* Organize complex, ambiguous problems into prioritized milestones, deliverables, and success criteria for engagements, translating business objectives into execution strategy (tactical and strategic).
* Help manage risks, dependencies and escalate impediments, as well as releases and navigating AI release requirements.

Establish and Maintain Product & Engineering Partnerships + Feedback Loops

* Serve as central liaison between Strategic Partnerships, Applied AI FDE, Product, Engineering, Experience (UI/UX) and supporting orgs.
* Define and operationalize a structured model for engaging Strategic partnership team and broader APEX org.
* Work with Strategic Partnership leaders to translate engagement insights and patterns into actionable product feedback, influencing and tracking engagement to platform innovation progress.
* Develop standardized intake templates, RACIs, and collaboration playbooks.

Drive Build Scale & Repeatability

* Capture lessons from early engagements (Phase 0 setup through rollout) and codify best practices.

jobs.description:
**Project Manager (Redwood City, CA)**

**JOB SUMMARY**  
The Project Manager (PM I) leads the planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery of business and technology initiatives that support organizational objectives. This role manages projects from initiation through implementation and closure, including a brief post-production stabilization period. Upon successful stabilization, ownership and ongoing support are transitioned to the designated business and technology support teams.

The Project Manager serves as the primary point of contact for project delivery and partners closely with business stakeholders, executive sponsors, IT teams, vendors, operational partners, and leadership to coordinate activities, manage risks, track and resolve issues, ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget, and drive successful outcomes that align with business goals.

While the primary focus of this role is project leadership and delivery, the Project Manager is also expected to perform Business Analyst functions when project needs require. This includes facilitating requirements gathering, documenting business and functional requirements, analyzing business processes, supporting solution design discussions, validating business needs, and assisting with testing and implementation activities. The Project Manager serves as a bridge between business and technical teams to help ensure solutions meet business objectives and operational needs.

In addition to managing assigned projects, the Project Manager plays an active role in project portfolio demand and intake management. This includes reviewing incoming project requests, ensuring requests are properly documented and filed within the project intake system, validating completeness of submitted information, coordinating follow-up activities as needed, and maintaining visibility into the project demand pipeline.

**Essential Functions**

Ensure project documentation is accurate, complete, current, and maintained within approved repositories.

Document and maintain business requirements, functional requirements, business rules, process flows, use cases, and acceptance criteria.  
  
Analyze current-state and future-state business processes and identify opportunities for operational improvement and process optimization.  
  
Validate proposed solutions with stakeholders and confirm business needs, requirements, and project objectives have been addressed.

new_jobs.description:
**Overview**

Tergar International is a global nonprofit bringing the benefits of meditation to people in more than 100 countries. As we scale toward our North Star of supporting **100,000 practitioners**, our technology, data and AI capabilities have become central to how we reach and serve them — and that work now needs dedicated project management.

We are looking for a **Project Manager** to own a connected portfolio of four interconnected areas: our **data program**, our **stage 1 instrumentation**, our **AI implementation roadmap** and the **cross-functional interface** with the rest of the organisation. No one of these is the main focus — they draw on the same engineers, analysts and designers and share the same stakeholders, so they are planned and run as a single portfolio rather than as separate projects.

This is a building role. You will establish the planning function that sits in front of our technology teams: a single intake path for incoming work, scoping and prioritisation before delivery begins, capacity planned by decision rather than by whoever asks loudest, and reporting reliable enough to take straight to our leadership team. If you like creating order where there is currently goodwill and no structure, this is that role.

It is not a reporting or administrative role. Dashboards and status updates are the smallest part of it. The substance is relational and structural — understanding what is blocking each team, negotiating capacity between competing priorities, and holding the discipline that lets ambitious cross-functional work actually land.

**The portfolio**

**What it involves**

  

**Data Program**

The full project management cycle across our data and analytics work: partnering with each team, understanding blockers and needs, scoping and prioritising incoming requests, planning against real capacity, and holding a standing cadence of visible boards and written status. Includes coordinating measurement and funnel work with our product and marketing teams against one agreed source of truth.

**Stage 1 Instrumentation**

Next year's largest cross-functional body of work: data and marketing planned as one against the campaign calendar rather than arriving as emergencies. It carries our north-star conversion experiment programme — A/B tests on free-event and product transitions in three-month cycles, measured on leakage and next-product KPIs — coordinated across engineering, data, marketing and product.

**AI Implementation Roadmap**

A multi-year roadmap of workflow automations across our functional areas, each delivered for a named internal client. Live work is already underway, scaling through 2027. The discipline is what makes it fast: scoped workflows with a real client, delivering visible value area by area rather than adopting tools that later have to be unwound.

**Cross-functional Interface**

  

When initiatives elsewhere in the organisation need capacity from our technology teams, you negotiate it manager-to-manager against a published priority list, with any displaced work recorded. Nothing starts without scope, dates, and a sponsor.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Run a single intake path.** Requests for your teams arrive through one route, are classified within an agreed window, and land on a published priority list.
* **Ensure nothing starts without a plan.** Every accepted project carries scope, milestones, dependencies, and dates before work begins.
* **Hold the priority order.** Maintain a published order across the portfolio, with changes going through an agreed process rather than around it.
* **Plan capacity as a decision.** Cross-functional work draws on a defined, published share of each team's time. When demand exceeds it, the tradeoff is negotiated in writing and recorded.
* **Own your stakeholders.** Be the person requesters come to for expectations, status, tradeoffs, and dates — and give them answers they can plan against.
* **Maintain a standing reporting cadence.** An always-current board and written monthly status on every body of work, reliable enough to go straight to leadership without chasing.
* **Manage change deliberately.** Scope growth and mid-flight additions are impact-assessed, decided visibly, and recorded.
* **Build a demand forecast.** Gather quarterly demand plans from requesting teams so annual capacity and budget are sized against stated demand.
* **Work inside an AI-supported system.** Our project management backend carries documentation, boards, transcripts, and reporting, so your time goes to judgment, relationships, and delivery. You will help shape that system as one of the first automations on the roadmap you manage.

  

**Scope boundary:** capacity allocation, technical priorities, and assignments within the technology teams sit with those teams and their managers. You coordinate, plan, negotiate, and report.

**Profile & Requirements**

  

* **Experience:** 5+ years in project management, including real experience holding a portfolio of concurrent projects in a technical environment — data, engineering, platform or digital product work.
* **Credentials:**  
  **Formal project management training from PMI is desired** — PMP, CAPM or equivalent PMI coursework. Comparable formal training from another recognised body will also be considered.
* **Technical fluency:** Comfortable working closely with engineers, analysts and designers. You do not need to build, but you need to understand the work well enough to scope it, sequence it and question an estimate.
* **Structure in ambiguity:** A proven track record of standing up intake, prioritisation and reporting where none existed — and making it stick past the first month.
* **Negotiation and judgment:** Able to hold a priority list under pressure, and to say no with a reason to peers and senior stakeholders alike.
* **Communication:** Clear, direct, low-noise written communication. Written status is a core deliverable of this role, not an afterthought.

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Join the dynamic journey at Vynca, where we're passionate about transforming care for individuals with complex needs.  
  
We’re more than just a team; we're a close-knit community. Our shared commitment to caring for each other and those we serve is what sets us apart. Guided by our unwavering core values: Excellence, Compassion, Curiosity, and Integrity, we forge paths of success together. Join us in this transformative movement where you can contribute to making a profound difference every day.  
  
At Vynca, our mission is to provide comprehensive care for more quality days at home.

**About the job**

As Senior Project Manager, Strategic Implementation, you will lead the end-to-end execution of new market launches, new contract implementations, and other high-priority strategic initiatives that fuel Vynca's growth. This is a build role: you will design and implement the frameworks, governance, and tools, standing up a repeatable implementation function. You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with leaders across the organization to move initiatives from signed contract to live, revenue-generating operations. Success in this role requires equal parts structure and adaptability: the discipline of formal project management combined with the resourcefulness to operate in a fast-moving healthcare startup.

**What you'll do**

* Own end-to-end project management for new market entries, contract implementations or new lines of business, from kickoff through go-live and post-launch stabilization.
* Build the project management function and infrastructure for the organization — including governance models, intake processes, status reporting cadences, and playbooks.
* Translate signed contracts and new-market business cases into detailed implementation plans with clear milestones, dependencies, owners, and timelines.
* Lead cross-functional project teams spanning operations, account management, sales, analytics, marketing, compliance, product, IT, RCM and finance, holding workstream owners accountable without direct authority.
* Partner with and influence leaders at all levels of the organization, from front-line managers to the executive team, to align priorities and resolve roadblocks quickly.
* Design and implement value-based care program operations, coordinating readiness across teams.
* Identify risks and issues early, drive mitigation plans, and escalate proactively to leadership with clear options and recommendations.
* Apply Lean and process-improvement principles to continuously simplify and scale implementation processes as the company grows.
* Establish and track key implementation metrics (timeline adherence, milestone completion, launch readiness, post-launch performance) and report progress to executive leadership.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures and change-management plans to support each new market or contract launch.
* Ensure all implementation activities comply with applicable healthcare regulations and payer-specific requirements.
* Continuously improve the implementation playbook based on lessons learned, building institutional knowledge that makes each subsequent launch faster and lower-risk.

**Your experience and qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Operations, or a related field; advanced degree a plus, preferred.
* Minimum of 5-8 years of project management experience, including leading complex, value-based initiatives in a health-tech start-up environment.
* Demonstrated experience implementing new markets, new contracts, or new lines of business, ideally within a startup or high-growth environment.
* Experience with or strong working knowledge of value-based care and value-based payment program design and operations.
* Track record of building processes, structure, and tools from scratch rather than optimizing an existing, mature function.
* Exceptional cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align leaders at all levels of an organization.
* Strong executive presence and communication skills, including comfort presenting plans, risks, and results to senior leadership.
* Comfort operating with ambiguity and shifting priorities typical of an early-to-growth-stage healthcare company.
* PMP certification, required.
* Lean, Six Sigma, or other process-improvement certification or working knowledge, preferred.
* Knowledge of healthcare compliance requirements, including HIPAA and payer contracting standards, preferred.

*At this time we are only considering applicants in the following states:*  
*California, Georgia, Texas, Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Illinois, Nevada, North Carolina, Oregon, Utah and Washington.*

**Oracle Technical Project Manager — E-Business Suite and Fusion**

**Center of Excellence | Working alongside Tessera AI Agents**

**Remote, USA**

**Location:** Near-shore (Latin America) or offshore (e.g., India). Both are open, and we will evaluate strong candidates from either.

**Remote:** Yes, with a daily overlap of US business hours (full overlap for near-shore, at least 3–4 hours for offshore) and occasional travel to customer sites for kick-offs and go-lives as needed.

**Experience:** 12+ years

**Employment type:** Long-term contract, engaged directly or through a staffing partner.

**Positions:** 1

**Start date:** Immediate.

**Engagement model:** Multi-engagement delivery management role. Approximately 80% running several concurrent Oracle engagements — proofs of value, discovery and implementation work across E-Business Suite and Fusion — and 20% delivery standards, platform input and pre-sales support. Works with a daily overlap of US business hours alongside customers, Oracle architects and SMEs, Forward Deployed Engineers and the Principal Architects.

**About Tessera Labs**

Tessera is an AI-native platform for enterprise transformation. The multi-agent platform delivers governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM, and finance systems, cutting timelines from years to weeks and costs by more than half. Built on deep expertise across Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, Workday, and other systems of record, Tessera address the scope a system integrator would have traditionally taken up with the speed of execution and efficiency of an AI-native platform.

For decades, enterprises have struggled with fragmented business systems, where migrations have consumed hundreds of millions of dollars, data stayed inconsistent and unreliable, and business processes slowed under manual review. Tessera was founded to change that, for Oracle and every other system enterprises depend on. The name itself — a tessera, a single tile in a mosaic — reflects our mission: unifying the disparate pieces of the enterprise into a coherent whole. Tessera is an AI-powered, multi-agent platform that harmonizes systems and lets teams work in plain English.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for an Oracle Technical Project Manager to run Oracle E-Business Suite and Oracle Fusion Cloud engagements — several at the same time — from kick-off to go-live. Our architects decide what the solution should be; you make sure it gets built, tested, converted and cut over on the date we committed to, and that the customer can see exactly where it stands at every point in between.

This is a technical project management role, and that is deliberate. You need to know Oracle delivery well enough to manage the deliverables themselves, not just the dates: the RICEFW inventory, functional and technical specifications, configuration moving between environments, data conversion mock cycles, integration builds, test cycles and the cutover runbook. A project manager who cannot tell whether a mock conversion actually reconciled, or why a Fusion quarterly update threatens the test plan, will report green until the week it turns red.

Most of our customers are not simply upgrading Oracle. They come from SAP ECC, JD Edwards, PeopleSoft, Infor or home-grown systems, and many run EBS and Fusion side by side. Our engagements are also shorter and sharper than a traditional system integrator’s: proofs of value measured in weeks, with success criteria agreed up front and evidence of value expected at the end.

You will run these engagements with Tessera’s AI agents as part of the team, and you need to be genuinely fluent in using AI. The platform produces a large share of the analysis, specifications, configuration, code and test material. Your job is to plan around that: build review and approval gates into the plan, know where AI output needs a domain expert’s eye, track the value it delivers against the manual baseline, and use AI tools yourself to plan, report and spot risk faster. What the platform cannot do is hold a steering committee to a decision or tell a customer that the date is at risk. That is the role.

Two outcomes define the job. The first is engagements that land: on the date, inside the scope, with the customer’s sign-off and a reference we can use. The second is that each one makes the next easier to run, because what you learn goes into our delivery standards and the platform rather than staying in your head.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Engagement Planning and Governance (25%)**

* Own the plan on several concurrent Oracle engagements: scope, phases, milestones, dependencies, resourcing and the critical path — from discovery and fit-gap through build, testing, data conversion, cutover and hypercare.
* Set up and run governance: weekly checkpoints, daily syncs during execution, steering committees, RAID logs and clear escalation paths — and report status the customer’s executives can trust.
* Manage scope, budget and commercial terms: burn and forecast against fixed-fee and time-and-materials engagements, change requests and change orders, with no surprises for the client partner or the customer.
* Agree success criteria for proofs of value up front and track them through to an evidence-based close-out.

**2. Management of Technical Deliverables (35%)**

* Own the RICEFW inventory (reports, interfaces, conversions, extensions, forms and workflows) and drive each item through specification, build, review, test and sign-off.
* Manage functional and technical specifications, code and configuration as deliverables — with review gates, quality criteria and traceability from requirement to test.
* Plan and control environments and configuration movement: EBS instance strategy, cloning and patch windows (including R12.2 online patching); Fusion environment refreshes, Functional Setup Manager migrations and the quarterly update cycle.
* Run data conversion as a managed workstream: mock conversion cycles, reconciliation sign-off, defec

**Brief Description:**  
Our organization is actively seeking a highly motivated Senior Security Operations Center (SOC) Business Analyst to join our team!
  
  
We partner with the US national defense community to create fully integrated, resilient, and innovative digital solutions that enable them to make smart decisions in real-time. We work with our customers on everything from conquering their data to improving and safeguarding IT infrastructure. Our ultimate goal? To enhance our nation's ability to identify, address, and act – no matter what challenges arise.
  
  
**Clearance Required:** Active TS/SCI
  
  
**Location:** Local remote with up to 40% travel within the National Capitol Region (NCR)
  
  
**Description:**  
The Senior Business Analyst reports directly to the SOC Program Manager and leads requirements elicitation for a Security Operations Center (SOC). The role turns mission needs, threat realities, and compliance mandates into a validated, traceable requirements baseline that architects, engineers, and analyst staff can build and operate against.
  
  
**Essential Duties:**  

* Bridges between the SOC Program Lead, who owns mission outcomes, and the SOC Technical Architect, who owns the technical design, making sure that what the program commits to and what the architecture delivers trace to the same validated requirements.
* Presents prioritized requirements and trade-offs so the Program Lead can make scope, cost, and schedule decisions.
* Escalates unresolved stakeholder conflicts, requirement risks, and dependencies with recommended courses of action.
* Prepares requirements content for leadership briefings, governance boards, and acquisition documents.
* Collaborates with the SOC Technical Architect early so requirements reflect technical realities, such as classification boundaries, cross-domain needs, and existing enterprise systems.
* Validates that each requirement is feasible, unambiguous, and testable before it is baselined.
* Assesses the impact of proposed design and requirement changes
* Holds a regular joint working session to review requirements status, open issues, and design decisions.
* Identifies and maps stakeholders across mission owners, SOC operators, intelligence partners, IT operations, legal, privacy, and acquisition.
* Plans and facilitates interviews, workshops, and site visits to capture current-state pain points and future-state needs.
* Elicits requirements for core SOC functions: 24x7 monitoring, threat detection, incident response, threat intelligence, threat hunting, and vulnerability management.
* Documents current-state (as-is) and target-state (to-be) SOC processes, workflows, and escalation paths, and run gap analysis between them.
* Writes business, functional, non-functional, security, and interface requirements in clear, testable language.
* Develops concept of operations (CONOPS) inputs, use cases, user stories, operational scenarios, and SOC playbook requirements.
* Defines requirements for tooling categories such as SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, NDR, log management, case management, and threat intelligence platforms, without bias toward any vendor.
* Builds and maintains a requirements traceability matrix (RTM) linking each requirement to its source, design element, and verification method

**Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor's degree in information systems, cybersecurity, computer science, business, or a related field;
* 12+ years of business or systems analysis experience, with 5+ years in federal, DoD, or Intelligence Community environments.
* CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, or CISSP required.

Get on board!
  
We are a progressive IT solutions provider. We offer excellent salaries and benefits in a fun and energized work environment. We are committed to rewarding goal-oriented professionals who enjoy meeting challenges head-on.

Amentum is a global leader in advanced engineering and innovative technology solutions, trusted by the United States and its allies to address their most significant and complex challenges in science, security and sustainability. Our commitments are underpinned by the belief that safety, collaboration and well-being are integral to success. The **Senior Cybersecurity Risk Analyst** is a US remote, senior individual contributor position within the Cybersecurity Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GR&C) team. This role owns the enterprise's cyber risk assessment work: evaluating activities and operational decisions across the enterprise and articulating the resulting cyber risk to business leadership against the enterprise's risk appetite.

The work is assessment heavy. The Senior Cybersecurity Risk Analyst examines technology and operational decisions for cyber risk that compliance-driven review alone does not surface, then frames that risk in business terms so GR&C and leaders can make informed accept, mitigate, or remediate decisions. The role is a twin to the Compliance function: where Compliance concentrates on the administrative work of demonstrating conformance to mandatory controls, this role works alongside it to drive cohesive cyber risk management across the enterprise regardless of which framework imposes a given requirement.

Consistent with the GR&C charter, the role helps protect Amentum against internal and external cyber threats and helps set, improve, and make recommendations on the enterprise security program based on industry best practices, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines. GR&C surfaces and advises on risk so that business and operational owners can make informed decisions. This person must be technical enough to recognize risk in networking, cloud, endpoint, and identity decisions made by engineering and IT, and credible enough that their risk judgments carry weight with those teams and with leadership. **Job description**

**About this role**

**Forward Deployed Business Analyst – BlackRock Transformation Office (BTO)**

  
  

The BlackRock Transformation Office (BTO) is a global group of change professionals that delivers strategic transformation to help make BlackRock greater than the sum of its parts. We drive 1BLK outcomes by continuously connecting and being students of the firm’s people, processes and technology.

We are a versatile team with varied experiences and backgrounds, motivated by the challenge of finding solutions that benefit BlackRock and our clients. In BTO, we focus on developing our people, strengthening leadership and delivery skills, and broadening firm and industry knowledge. Projects and roles consider both successful delivery and individual development objectives and career aspirations.

  
  

**Your role and impact**

The Forward Deployed Business Analyst will work in cross-functional teams to reimagine, innovate and scale solutions that drive growth and operating models within the firm.

  
  

This is not a traditional business analysis role centered on gathering requirements and handing them to technology. The role combines business analysis, product discovery, business architecture and hands-on prototyping to turn ambiguous problems into tangible solutions that business users and engineers can test and refine together.

  
  

Successful candidates will combine the structured thinking of a business analyst, the prioritization instincts of a product owner, the enterprise perspective of a business architect and the bias to action of a hands-on builder.

new_jobs.description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

  
  

The Company operates Snapchat , a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc. , a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji , Saturn, and other digital services.

  
  

Snap Engineering teams build fun and technically sophisticated products that reach hundreds of millions of Snapchatters around the world, every day. We’re deeply committed to the well-being of everyone in our global community, which is why our values are at the root of everything we do. We move fast, with precision, and always execute with privacy at the forefront.

  
  

We are seeking a Security Technical Program Manager (Security TPM) to help operate and scale the programs that protect Snap’s data, systems, identities, and customer experience.

  
  

This role serves as a portfolio-level program leader across Access and Privacy Engineering. You will turn ambiguous privacy and security priorities into clear operating models, roadmaps, controls, execution plans, and measurable outcomes. You will partner with Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, Legal, Compliance, Security, and business teams to make the right work visible, actionable, and sustainable.

  
  

The role supports the full lifecycle of privacy and security risk: identifying signals, establishing ownership, defining requirements, prioritizing work, driving adoption, validating outcomes, and communicating decisions and residual risk to leadership

.

What you’ll do

* Own the cross-functional privacy and data governance, translating strategy into priorities, roadmaps, and execution plans.
* Build operating mechanisms for intake, prioritization, decision-making, escalation, dependency management, exceptions, and closure.
* Drive privacy-by-design programs that define data use, retention, access, sharing, minimization, and control requirements early in the lifecycle.
* Coordinate material reviews and clarify technical feasibility, required approvals, controls, decision rights, and ownership.
* Lead complex, company-wide programs through rollout, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.
* Provide leadership visibility, resolve blockers, and automate program workflows where appropriate.
  

  

Knowledge, skills, and abilities

  
  

* Strong understanding of privacy engineering, data governance, information security, and risk management.
* Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional technical programs in privacy engineering, data governance, security, data, infrastructure, or platform environments.
* Ability to connect technical and control requirements to business outcomes, customer experience, operational risk, and regulatory obligations.
* Experience building operating models, governance mechanisms, roadmaps, metrics, decision frameworks, and leadership reporting in ambiguous domains.
* Strong technical judgment, including the ability to evaluate trade-offs, clarify approval requirements, and distinguish facts, decisions, dependencies, and residual risk.
* Track record of driving adoption of platforms, standards, controls, and processes across teams with varied incentives and maturity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, organization, prioritization, facilitation, and follow-through across long-running programs.
* Collaborative leader who builds trust, resolves conflict, facilitates decisions, and mentors program managers.
  

  

Minimum qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6+ years of experience in technical program management in the privacy engineering, compliance, risk management, or technical solution delivery domains
* Demonstrated experience leading privacy engineering programs across multiple engineering or business organizations.
* Demonstrated experience converting ambiguous requirements or risk signals into measurable execution plans and outcomes.
  

  

Preferred qualifications

* Experience with privacy-by-design, data lifecycle governance, data classification, data inventories, data access, retention, deletion, or third-party data risk
* Experience with GDPR, CCPA, NIST Privacy Framework, ISO 42001, NIST 2.0, ISO 27001, or comparable frameworks.
* Experience building common-control frameworks, second-line monitoring, audit evidence, risk registers, or control-health reporting.
* Experience operating in cloud-based environments such as Google Cloud or AWS.
* Experience using automation, scripting, workflow tools, or data analysis to improve program execution.
* Security, privacy, audit, risk, or cloud certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CIPM, CIPT, CIPP, or CCSP are a plus.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Project Manager (Redwood City, CA)**

**JOB SUMMARY**  
The Project Manager (PM I) leads the planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery of business and technology initiatives that support organizational objectives. This role manages projects from initiation through implementation and closure, including a brief post-production stabilization period. Upon successful stabilization, ownership and ongoing support are transitioned to the designated business and technology support teams.

The Project Manager serves as the primary point of contact for project delivery and partners closely with business stakeholders, executive sponsors, IT teams, vendors, operational partners, and leadership to coordinate activities, manage risks, track and resolve issues, ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget, and drive successful outcomes that align with business goals.

While the primary focus of this role is project leadership and delivery, the Project Manager is also expected to perform Business Analyst functions when project needs require. This includes facilitating requirements gathering, documenting business and functional requirements, analyzing business processes, supporting solution design discussions, validating business needs, and assisting with testing and implementation activities. The Project Manager serves as a bridge between business and technical teams to help ensure solutions meet business objectives and operational needs.

In addition to managing assigned projects, the Project Manager plays an active role in project portfolio demand and intake management. This includes reviewing incoming project requests, ensuring requests are properly documented and filed within the project intake system, validating completeness of submitted information, coordinating follow-up activities as needed, and maintaining visibility into the project demand pipeline.

**Essential Functions**  
Essential Functions
  
Project Implementation & Delivery
  
Lead approved and prioritized cross-functional business and technology projects from initiation through closure.
  
Ensure Vendor Management due diligence requirements have been completed by the project owner prior to project implementation.  
  
Conduct stakeholder analysis and define project scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones, assumptions, constraints, and dependencies in partnership with project sponsors and stakeholders.  
  
Develop and maintain risk registers, including risk identification, assessment, mitigation strategies, and contingency plans, to minimize organizational exposure and project risk.  
  
Develop project work plans, schedules, key milestones, and target dates; drive project execution and adjust plans as necessary to ensure successful delivery of committed outcomes.  
  
Effectively apply PMO methodologies and enforce project governance, implementation, and delivery standards.  
  
Ensure project documentation is accurate, complete, current, and maintained within approved repositories.  
  
Business Analysis & Solution Validation  
  
Facilitate requirements gathering sessions with business stakeholders, subject matter experts, vendors, and technical teams.  
  
Document and maintain business requirements, functional requirements, business rules, process flows, use cases, and acceptance criteria.  
  
Analyze current-state and future-state business processes and identify opportunities for operational improvement and process optimization.  
  
Validate proposed solutions with stakeholders and confirm business needs, requirements, and project objectives have been addressed.  
  
Testing, Implementation & Operational Readiness  
  
Coordinate testing activities, user acceptance testing, implementation planning, deployment readiness, and go-live activities.  
  
Partner with impacted business units to ensure operational procedures, departmental workflows, job aids, training materials, and supporting documentation are developed or updated to reflect new or modified processes, systems, controls, regulatory requirements, and operational changes introduced by the project.  
  
Ensure all tracked issues, defects, risks, and action items are resolved, mitigated, formally accepted, or appropriately documented prior to deployment.  
  
Confirm stakeholder expectations have been met and obtain final approval and signoff from impacted business owners and the appropriate Vice President(s) prior to production deployment.  
  
Facilitate a successful transition to operational ownership and support following implementation and stabilization.  
  
Portfolio Intake & Demand Management  
  
Support administration and management of the project portfolio demand and intake pipeline.  
  
Ensure project requests are appropriately documented, categorized, tracked, and routed through the intake process.  
  
Maintain accurate intake and portfolio records to support project prioritization, capacity planning, and portfolio reporting.  
  
Provide visibility into project demand, resource needs, and portfolio pipeline status to leadership.  
  
**Knowledge & Business Acumen**

**Financial & Operational Management**  

* Understand project budgeting, financial planning, and cost management principles.
* Understand cost-benefit analysis and business case development.
* Understand vendor contracts, project-related legal documents, and procurement processes.

**Technical Knowledge**  

* Understand software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies and information technology concepts.
* Understand web-based, cloud, internet, and client-server architectures.
* Awareness of emerging technologies and industry trends.
* Proficiency with project management and business analysis tools, including Microsoft Project, OneNote, Visio, Jira, Microsoft Office Suite, MS Teams, and other tools.

  
**Analytical & Communication Skills**

* Ability to synthesize complex information from multiple stakeholders, business units, vendors, and technical team

**California School Employees Association**  
**Senior Research Analyst - San Jose, CA**

**DEFINITION**  
Independently leads assigned research projects, prepares and issues reports, analyzes external technical studies and research, and develops strategic plans and campaigns to support Field Operations. This position is supervised by and reports to the Director and Assistant Director of Field Operations.

**Role of the Research Analyst:**  
The Senior Research Analyst plays a critical strategic role in providing the foundational groundwork for tactical initiatives deployed in the field. This unique position supports field staff and Field Operations leadership by delivering essential data and insights that drive the representational work and strategic goals of the organization.

The Senior Research Analyst independently conducts the most complex and sensitive research assignments requiring advanced methodologies and policy expertise. A person in this position is expected to independently produce high caliber work product. Included in this definition are white papers, which are reports or guides that inform readers concisely about a complex issue, presenting CSEA’s philosophy on the subject and the impact to CSEA members and the organization as a whole such that the reports and guides support broad understanding of the subject or they solve a problem or they help make high profile and high consequence decisions.

This dedicated strategic role is expected to work independently with minimal daily supervision, as well as mentor and collaborate with Research Analysts. The position demands strong technical and organizational skills, coupled with strong writing and presentation skills when translating findings to both staff executives and rank-and-file members. A comprehensive understanding of current research best practices is essential, and the analyst must be proactive in staying apprised of new tactics in the research field in order to develop actionable, targeted recommendations.

The Senior Research Analyst is also responsible for making administrative decisions concerning all non-technical aspects of departmental operations related to their position within general policies established by the department managers.

new_jobs.title: Inventory Planning Strategy Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**

The Inventory Planning Strategy Analyst will support the Senior Manager of Inventory Planning Strategy in implementing and sustaining inventory planning capabilities across Williams-Sonoma, Inc. brands. This role will translate approved processes, standards, and system changes into clear documentation, training, presentations, communications, and project resources. The Analyst will partner with Program Managers, brand teams, subject matter experts, Technology, and Business Intelligence to help users adopt tools, follow best practices, and make effective data-driven decisions.

**Primary Functions:**

* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, process maps, job aids, training decks, FAQs, onboarding guides, templates, and other user resources.
* Translate process designs, requirements, system changes, and implementation guidance into clear, practical materials for brand users.
* Support rollouts by coordinating timelines, meetings, agendas, action logs, stakeholder communications, training logistics, feedback collection, and follow-up.
* Prepare presentations, project updates, status reports, and leadership materials summarizing progress, decisions, risks, adoption, and next steps.
* Maintain organized repositories of current standards, documentation, training resources, templates, decisions, and project artifacts with appropriate version control.
* Assist with workshops, training, user acceptance testing, and post-launch support by preparing materials, documenting outcomes, tracking issues, and coordinating resolution.
* Collect and synthesize user feedback, adoption information, recurring questions, and process issues to identify documentation gaps, training needs, and improvement opportunities.
* Build effective relationships across brands and functions while ensuring communications and deliverables are accurate, consistent, accessible, and timely.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of experience in retail inventory planning, merchandising, business operations, project coordination, process improvement, or a related role.
* Working knowledge of retail inventory planning processes, tools, and reporting.
* Ability to create clear process documentation, presentations, training materials, and written communications.
* Strong organizational and project-coordination skills, with the ability to manage deadlines, action items, and multiple priorities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Teams, and SharePoint or comparable tools.
* Strong communication, attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and ability to work effectively with technical and nontechnical partners.

**Our Culture & Values**  
  
We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success, and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.  
  
**People First**  
  
Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:  
  
**Benefits**  
  
- A generous discount on all WSI brands  
  
- A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities  
  
- Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer  
  
- Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits  
  
- Tax-free commuter benefits  
  
- A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health  
  
**Continued Learning**  
  
- In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University  
  
- Cross-brand and cross-function career opportunities  
  
- Resources for self-development  
  
- Advisor (Mentor) program  
  
- Career development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series  
  
  
WSI will not now or in the future commence an immigration case or "sponsor" an individual for this position (for example, H-1B or other employment-based immigration).

This role is not eligible for relocation assistance.

Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Williams-Sonoma, Inc. will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, or other applicable state or local laws and ordinances.

The expected starting pay range for this position is $71,000-$83,000. Applicable pay ranges may differ across markets. Actual pay will be determined based on experience and other job-related factors permitted by law. In addition to competitive pay, compensation may include a variety of other components like benefits, paid time off, merit, and bonus opportunities.

  

Our Company
  
  
Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Our family of brands are Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, Rejuvenation, West Elm, Mark & Graham, Outward, and GreenRow. These brands are among the best known and most respected in the industry. We offer beautifully-designed, stylish and functional products for every area of the home, including the kitchen, living room, bedroom, home office, closet, laundry room and even outdoor spaces. We've seen some big changes since our first brick-and-mortar store opened more than half of a century ago. What hasn't changed is our passion for high-quality products, functional design, outstanding customer service, and enhancing the lives of our customers and the communities where we operate. Today, we're a multi-brand, multi-channel, global enterprise supported by state-of-the-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing - and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.
